name: wizard
title: Multi-step wizard
description: A three-step onboarding wizard: ui/steps (progress list with aria-current="step"), comp/onboarding-wizard (one step at a time, Next validates only the current step and moves focus to the first error, Back keeps the values, a review step, Finish emits the collected data and shows a busy state) and views/onboarding.brain, which saves through a server function that validates again.
notes: Add a step: one entry in `steps`, its fields, one {#if step === n} block and its rule in `problems()`. Link /onboarding from the nav or after sign-up.
